description: Finalize a local file upload started with upload_file_start. Call this only AFTER the curl PUT has finished successfully. Pass exactly one of: asset_id (a video: verifies the file landed in storage and starts video processing) or image_url (an image: creates the image asset - at the team's top level, in folder_id, or as a new version of version_of - titled title). Safe to retry: a repeat returns the same asset.

asset_id.description: The asset_id (version id) upload_file_start returned for a video

folder_id.description: Image only: folder to create it in (omit for the team's top level)

image_url.description: The image_url upload_file_start returned for an image

title.description: Image only: title for the new asset (defaults to the file name)

version_of.description: Image only: add the image as a new version of this asset (any of its ids). For a video it is ignored: the version is attached at upload_file_start.

name: upload_file_complete
title: Finish local file upload
